{{- /* creator/prev-next.html — previous / next note in the same folder (card order). (dict "node" "nodes") */ -}} {{- $n := .node -}} {{- $sibs := where (where .nodes "parent" $n.parent) "g" 1 -}} {{- $sibs = partial "creator/sort-pages.html" (dict "nodes" $sibs "by" "cards") | transform.Unmarshal -}} {{- $prev := "" -}}{{- $next := "" -}}{{- $found := false -}}{{- $last := "" -}} {{- range $sibs -}} {{- if $found -}} {{- if not $next -}}{{- $next = . -}}{{- end -}} {{- else if eq .slug $n.slug -}} {{- $found = true -}}{{- $prev = $last -}} {{- else -}} {{- $last = . -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if or $prev $next -}}
{{- with $prev -}} {{ partial "creator/icon.html" (dict "name" "arrow-left" "size" 14) }}{{ i18n "creator.previous" }}{{ .title }} {{- end -}} {{- with $next -}} {{ i18n "creator.next" }}{{ partial "creator/icon.html" (dict "name" "arrow-right" "size" 14) }}{{ .title }} {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
